workarounds.note: the contents' part rows carry no {pageNumber}: with parts.page false there is no divider page, so a part has no page label to print (gotcha toc-part-rows-no-label)

col() writes each colour's hex beside its paletteId, because 1.4.1 does not apply colorPalette to design elements (gotcha palette-skips-designs); a part's palette still recolours them through the paletteId
a story opener's picture reserves no height (gotcha opener-image-no-reserve): the band panel and the byline reach below the picture's foot, so they set where the story starts, with no minHeight
the H1 breakBefore is restated because any headings object drops it (gotcha headings-drop-h1-break)
design text lineHeight is a multiple of the size (0.86, 1, 1.02, 1.05, 1.12, 1.35): a pt() value silently drops an opener's reserved height in 1.4.1 (gotcha design-lineheight-multiple)

the stacked text boxes of the cover lines, the price box and barcode, and the opener panel overlap by SEAM (0.3 mm): on the canvas two design box fills (box.backgroundColor) that meet at a fractional pixel leave a hairline of the picture between them, the same seam EF-64 records for adjacent table-cell fills, whose proposed fix covers only table cells (with SEAM 0 the seams show on pages 1, 3, 4 and 6)

bodyText.maxRuntTracking is 0 (gotcha runt-tracking-unpainted): in 1.4.1 a runt fix can give a paragraph negative tracking (a block letterSpacing), which the layout measures but the canvas and postext-pdf renderers paint only above 0; its justified lines then crush their word spaces (painted segment by segment, overlapping by under 1 px), and an unstyled ragged last line, painted with one fillText, runs about 1.9 mm past the column edge and is clipped (the Spanish feature once printed 'como todo el mund', its 'o.' cut); word spacing alone still shortens runts, and the remaining runts were copy-fitted
